description: Election Commission - Declare that L. E. S, Rathnayaka as a member of the Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member, which is directly related to electoral processes and the composition of an elected body, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
